messages.author: Adolf Oliver Nipples
messages.text: With just 17 days remaining in season, the trade office is officially open. Feel free to submit proposals. Also be advised of the following : Announcement. Anytime one you acquire a 2nd rounder and then pass on that second rounder in the draft, you’re permanently banned from acquiring second rounders going forward. This is a 1 strike you’re out rule. I will be watching very closely for this.
